The Miron approach

We see the potential.
You see what’s next.

Selling a home is a big decision.
Getting started can be simple.

Miron buys homes with the intention of renovating and reselling them. It starts by understanding your property and what you want from a sale.

Whether you’re moving, managing an inherited property, or considering what to do with a home that needs work, a conversation can help you understand the next step.

Let’s talk about your home

A little clarity

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Your home is personal.
There’s room for every question.

How is a cash offer determined?+

The property’s condition, location, expected renovation costs, and comparable sales help inform an offer. You can ask how those factors apply to your home before deciding.

Does my home need to be move-in ready?+

Tell us about its current condition, including any repairs you know it needs. Miron’s approach includes renovation, and we’ll discuss whether your property is a fit before you make plans.

How quickly can a sale happen?+

The timeline depends on the property, title, agreed terms, and closing arrangements. Share your preferred timing during the first conversation so the available options can be discussed.

What costs should I expect?+

Review the written offer and closing terms for any fees, closing costs, and deductions. Ask for a breakdown of the amount you would receive before agreeing to a sale.

Do I have to accept an offer?+

No. You can consider an offer, ask questions, and decide whether it works for you before entering into an agreement.
